items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Duke Ellington was there - and you know, he was my idol. He and Count Basie and Fletcher Henderson

ctx.x: For her was a surprise. She knows the other musicians - because, you know, since she was a kid - but me!, drinking Coca-Cola? Well, she say, this fellow look like a clean-cut fellow; so it come to my mind to say to her: You know? I am looking for a job, and she said: "Well, I know a man that might get you a job. See me tomorrow, six-thirty or seven o'clock in the evening, 116th St. and 7th Ave., and I will take you to the place that you could get a job." So when I got here, you know, I had a white raincoat that I…

and she had the umbrella and the umbrella was upside-down, you know, - forget it! - so we got a taxi and we went to the Apollo Theatre and we happened to find that Duke Ellington was there - and you know, he was my idol. He and Count Basie and Fletcher Henderson, you name it; so we went out there and had a tremendous time. When the thing was over, I took her home and I didn't see her maybe for ten days, but I forgot her name. I forgot the address.

I got an idea where she lived, so one day - gee, I was so desperate - because she was beautiful - and I went to the 3rd Ave., between - almost on the corner - 116th - and I see her mother, that she was drying her hair - because she was very clean, beautiful woman too - and I asked her - she was living one flight up - I said: "Lady, you know the girl that lives mmmmmmm? "Yes, but she is not here, she is working", you know, very stern, and I said: "Oh", this, this thing - Huh - so I was - I went by and I was…
